title: Our Branding · The Short Guide
slide_intent: Introduce the book through a composition a reader can recognize before reading the full institutional name.
strategic_value: A cover made from the lab’s colors and tilted contours can establish a vocabulary that the building and pattern pages later explain.
demonstration: A small two-line title sits above oversized ochre and yellow shapes. A gray strip at right carries the laboratory description vertically.
practical_value: Use the cover to study how little text a large graphic needs when the audience already holds the guide.

content_islands.name: Title
content_islands.spec: Place a compact gray title and subtitle in the white upper-left area.

content_islands.name: Oversized shapes
content_islands.spec: Intersect a rust-colored field with a large yellow form whose curved top and angled side continue past the page edges.

content_islands.name: Vertical identifier
content_islands.spec: Run a gray band down the right edge and set the guide descriptor vertically within it.
